newsitem.title: USA: Foreign share of Japan chip market falls in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Foreign share of Japan chip market falls in Q2.

text.p: The foreign share of Japan's computer chip market fell in the second quarter to 26.4 percent, while the first quarter share was revised downward, the U.S. Trade Representative's office said Friday.

The USTR said the foreign share of Japan's computer chip market was 26.9 percent instead of the 30.6 percent share previously estimated. The agency said the sharp revision was due to erroneous information provided by Tokyo on the size of the Japanese market.

The first quarter revision is significant because Japan pointed to the large 30.6 percent share in arguing against renewing a trade agreement with the United States aimed at opening Japan's market to more foreign competition.
After tense negotiations, the two sides last summer agreed to modified plan that left to industry groups the task of monitoring market share data.
